barRaise.topFinding: Two independent lenses this run confirmed the same live breakage on the real money path: worker/src/handlers/billing.js's handleBillingCheckout and handleBillingPortal still trust a client-supplied body.userId with no Supabase JWT verification, and a separate unauthenticated endpoint (GET /api/courses/:slug/edit-history) leaks real contributor user IDs, so any signed-in user can harvest a victim's ID and open a live Stripe Billing Portal session for that victim's account. This sits alongside two new stored-XSS findings (round.ts pin labels, strategy-admin.ts course names) and a still-missing billing incident runbook. The good news: the 16-commit burst that took the app from 0.58.3 to 1.6.0 and crossed the 1.0 launch on 2026-08-01 genuinely closed 18 chronic findings, including several that had been open 24-27 consecutive passes (the RLS privilege-escalation gap, the unsanitized consensus write, the Stripe-cancel-on-delete gap, and the AI-spend cap on photo endpoints). The bad news is concentrated in the automation layer: three orchestration lenses (skill-chain-handoff-integrity, skill-trigger-collisions, discord-notify-wiring) scored in the 30s this run after finding a batch queue closure on 2026-08-01 that marked two findings completed with a copy-pasted note from an unrelated fix, neither of which actually landed, and one of which (the CLAUDE.md routing-table gap) has since silently vanished from the canonical audit as a direct result.

actions.title: Add _verifySupabaseUser(req, env) to handleBillingCheckout and handleBillingPortal (worker/src/handlers/billing.js:575-667) exactly as already done for handleBillingCancelForDeletion, derive userId from the verified session, and have src/subscription.ts send the Supabase access token instead of a body userId. GET /api/courses/:slug/edit-history also leaks real userIds unauthenticated -- lock that down too. [CHRONIC x25]

Shard course-index:by-name (state or prefix), add short-TTL in-worker memoization, set Cache-Control on library/lookup responses, and stop handleCoursesNearby from rewriting the full 13,000+-entry index on the public path. [CHRONIC x6]

Add the .work-queue-archive.json read-back step to 05_meta_synthesis.md's auto-enqueue section and per_project.md's carry-forward path before the next bar-raise run. [CHRONIC x6]

Re-verify every queue item closed by the 2026-08-01 batch against its own title/evidence, reopen the two falsely-closed items (preship gate labels, CLAUDE.md routing table), and require a completion's cited commit to actually touch the file(s) named.

Rewrite the README intro to match the 'built but hidden' framing, drop the pre-public-release license line, and state the Yes& Chains Pro paywall exists. [CHRONIC x5]
Apply the same tombstone fix already used for bags/discs/collection to course_favorites (cloudSyncCoursesAndOverlays), or gate the delete block on a per-session loaded flag.
Call cloudSyncRoundHistory() at the end of cloudLoadAll, same place persist()/persistCourses() already push their tables, so local-only round history reaches the cloud immediately.
Add an _rev integer to COURSE_FIELDS, increment on every canonical write, and have each of the five write sites retry or fail on a stale _rev. [CHRONIC x6]
Add a node:test file mirroring billing_webhook.test.mjs that imports subscription.ts and asserts flag-gating behaviour under all states, wired into npm test + preship Gate 8d. [CHRONIC x6]
Capture the wrangler deploy exit code and annotate or skip the Discord 'shipped' post when it's non-zero.

Wrap course.name and layout.name in escape() at src/strategy-admin.ts:71-72, same pattern already used in course-detail-edit.ts.

Filter refreshCourseMapPins() to the current viewport bounds plus margin, and switch to a lazy popup built on popupopen -- the course library has grown to 13,015+ records since this was first flagged.

Rewrite the two bullet lines in _renderUpgradeModal() (subscription.ts:212, :215) without em dashes -- this is the live Pro-upgrade paywall's sales copy.

Update .project-context.json's milestone block to shipped/closed status (or a real post-1.0 milestone), replacing completion.remaining with the actual open N3-N6 items -- 1.0.0 shipped six versions ago and the doc still shows 94% in-progress.

Standardize every user-facing string on 'Yes& Chains' -- three spellings currently coexist, including two within the same Settings screen and one in outbound share text.

Add a warn-past-36h/fail-past-72h freshness assertion to audit_dashboard.py's sync() path comparing audit.latestReportAt to now().
Wrap the four Sync-*Version WriteAllText calls in release.ps1 in the same write-verify-retry loop already implemented in write-dashboard-status.ps1.

Update .project-context.json's scheduled_tasks field to the current shared task names (nightly-sweep, bar-raise-rotating) -- the two named there were retired 2026-07-30.
Batch the per-key KV gets in handleAdminCaddyUsage with Promise.all in fixed-size chunks, matching the pattern already used elsewhere in billing.js.
Add defer to the three unpkg script tags and a preconnect/dns-prefetch pair for unpkg.com.
Add integrity hashes and crossorigin to the markercluster and geoman script/link tags, matching the pattern already used for Leaflet core.
Merge the Step 3 and Step 3.5 PDGA fetch loops in handlePdgaCourseResearch into one pass, cutting ~420 subrequests roughly in half.
Add a pushServerError helper and call it from each billing.js catch block so server-side money-path failures reach the admin errors panel.
Add lightweight paywall_shown / checkout_started / subscription_activated emitters in subscription.ts -- the live paywall funnel has zero client-side drop-off visibility.

Re-derive the per-user AI-recommender caps in CONTEXT.md against the real $1/mo price before CHAINS_VISIBLE flips to true; a maxed-out subscriber could cost 4-6x their subscription revenue at the current cap.
Port the anthropic-skills copy's Phase 8 auto-enqueue block into the personal-skills project-canonical-audit copy, or strike the queue-these claim from its description.
Collapse both admin-token localStorage keys (yac_admin_token vs caddyAdminToken) onto one and delete the other's read/write sites.

Add a worker test that statically diffs every field a handler assigns against COURSE_FIELDS/HOLE_FIELDS/PIN_FIELDS and fails on any missing field -- this whitelist-drift class already caused one silent data-loss incident.
Add an explicit exemption for legal/*.md and src/legal-view.ts from AI-tool-name flagging and auto-fix; those files now legitimately name Anthropic/Claude as required subprocessor disclosures.
Add a 'Rolling back a bad worker deploy' section to scripts/README.md documenting wrangler deployments list / wrangler rollback and a post-rollback health check.
Extend audit_dashboard.py's sync() to compare live version/release state against the dashboard JSON and exit non-zero on disagreement.
Update the live project-canonical-audit and drift-auto-fix skill copies to always emit the literal '## Auto-enqueued: N' receipt line, per the skill's own Phase-8 spec.
Add an explicit age/eligibility checkbox or equivalent affirmative step to the sign-in modal -- there is still no active age-attestation mechanism.
Update the billing.js 402 message and the Stripe product display name from the retired 'Chains AI' to 'Yes& Chains Pro'.
Fix the hazard_catalog path template in PERSONAL_CLAUDE_ARCHITECTURE.md and add a billing/subscription section to hazards/per-project/YaC.md.
Have the dashboard-sync script count blocked-on-user items alongside pending in itemsLeft.queue so the headline metric reflects all open work.
Add a real admin-token input field under Settings > Admin, or rewrite the strategy-admin toast to point at the actual dev-console command.

Widen voice_scope to explicitly cover src/ UI strings and run a dedicated prose-voice-sweep pass, or explicitly document the em-dash rule as docs-only -- ~203 em-dash hits exist across 28 of ~29 source files, outside the project's own declared enforcement boundary.
